basic_details.job_title: Northeast Frontier Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27: 56 Vacancies for Sportspersons
basic_details.short_information: Northeast Frontier Railway (NF Railway) has released Employment Notice No. 04/2026, inviting applications from eligible sportspersons for recruitment against the Sports Quota for the year 2026-27. A total of 56 posts are on offer - 21 posts in Level-3/2 of the Pay Matrix and 35 posts in Level-1 of the Pay Matrix, both under the 7th Central Pay Commission. Applications are invited from Indian citizens who meet the specified sports norms. This article covers the vacancy details, educational qualification, age limit, and sports norms, based on the official notice.

content_sections.heading: Northeast Frontier Railway Sports Quota Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. The candidate must be an eligible sportsperson meeting the sports norms prescribed for the applied level (see below).

content_sections.heading: Northeast Frontier Railway Sports Quota Educational Qualification

rows.educational_qualification: Passed Class 12th (+2 stage) or its equivalent examination from a government-recognized Board/Council/Institution
Passed Class 10th (matriculation), or ITI, or an equivalent qualification, or a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT

content_sections.heading: Northeast Frontier Railway Sports Quota Sports Norms
content_sections.text: For Level-3/2 posts (21 vacancies), a candidate must satisfy at least one of the following: Represented the country in any Category-B championship/event, or Secured at least 3rd position in any Category-C championship/event, or Secured at least 3rd position in Senior/Youth/Junior National Championships, or Secured at least 3rd position in National Games organized under the aegis of the Indian Olympic Association, or Secured at least 3rd position in All India Inter-University Championships organized under the aegis of the Association of Indian Universities, or Secured 1st position in Federation Cup Championships (Senior Category). For Level-1 posts (35 vacancies), a candidate must satisfy at least one of the following: Represented the country in any Category-C championship/event, or Secured at least 3rd position in Federation Cup Championships (Senior Category), or Represented a state or an equivalent unit - except in marathon and cross country, where at least 8th position in Senior National Championships is required.

content_sections.heading: Northeast Frontier Railway Sports Quota: Categories of International Championships
content_sections.text: Note: In Boxing, achievements of players in the "Youth" category on or after 25.09.2016 in International Championships will be considered in place of the "Junior" category.

rows.championships_events: World Cup (Junior/Youth/Senior), World Championships (Junior/Senior), Asian Games (Senior), Commonwealth Games (Senior), Youth Olympics, Davis Cup (Tennis), Champions Trophy (Hockey), Thomas/Uber Cup (Badminton)

Commonwealth Championships (Junior/Senior), Asian Championships/Asia Cup (Junior/Senior), South Asian Federations (SAF) Games (Senior), USIC (World Railways) Championship (Senior), World University Games

content_sections.heading: NF Railway Sports Quota Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed in Level-3/2 or Level-1 of the Pay Matrix under the 7th Central Pay Commission, depending on the post. An exact monthly salary figure is not specified in this notice. Sportspersons looking for similar opportunities can also explore more Sports Quota Government Jobs and Railway Recruitment openings across India. Candidates based in the Northeast can check the latest Assam Government Jobs for more opportunities in the region. Those who have completed Class 10th or 12th can also browse 10th Pass Government Jobs and 12th Pass Government Jobs matching their qualification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NF Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: There are 56 vacancies in total - 21 posts in Level-3/2 and 35 posts in Level-1 of the Pay Matrix (7th CPC).

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for NF Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: 18 to 25 years, as on 1 January 2027, for both Level-3/2 and Level-1 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification for NF Railway Sports Quota Level-3/2 posts?
faq.answer: Passed Class 12th (+2 stage) or its equivalent examination from a government-recognized Board/Council/Institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for NF Railway Sports Quota Level-1 posts?
faq.answer: Passed Class 10th (matriculation), or ITI, or an equivalent qualification, or a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT.

faq.question: Q5. What sports achievements are required for NF Railway Sports Quota Level-3/2 posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need international representation (Category-B), or at least 3rd position in Category-C events, National Championships, National Games, or All India Inter-University Championships, or 1st position in the Federation Cup (Senior).

faq.question: Q6. What sports achievements are required for NF Railway Sports Quota Level-1 posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need international representation (Category-C), at least 3rd position in the Federation Cup (Senior), or state-level representation with at least 8th position in Senior National Championships (except in marathon and cross country).
